existing_android_regressions.result: passed after updating test selectors and newest-first expectations
existing_android_regressions.initial_failures: Four comment tests assumed a single composer; one audio test assumed the oldest fixture post appeared first. All five passed on rerun.

coverage: Feed returns newest 100 posts before truncation, with descending ID tie-break and family isolation
Android sorts timezone-aware timestamps and IDs in both text sizes
Feed question entry opens the selected post and sends the question to its API
Answers appear in detail without creating family comments
Follow-up requests include at most ten prior messages of at most 1000 characters each
Failures preserve the draft and do not add failed turns to conversation history
Duplicate sends are blocked and comment input stays available during QA requests
Navigation discards late answers and does not leak conversation to another post
Existing inline audio, comment keyboard/send/retry, feed refresh, and photo loading behavior
test_services: Local mock HTTP API for Android; mocked AI/Graphiti in backend tests. No paid AI calls.
limitations: Live model answer quality and a deployed backend were not tested
Question history is kept only while the detail screen stays open
Physical devices and Android versions below API 36 were not tested
